RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the April 27, 2007/Vaisakha 7, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
114
Livestock package for Kerala
*361. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Government have decided to implement a
special livestock package for three districts
in Kerala  viz. Kasaragode, Wayanad and
Palakkad with a view to provide
supplementary avenues of income to the
suicide prone farming population in these
districts;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the funds
allotted for this programme during
2007-08; and
(c) whether Government have any plan
to extend this programme to other districts
in the State and if so, the details thereof?
Debt-burden and suicide in  Punjab
*362. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA:
SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
  Will the the Minister of
AGRICULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether a suicide census, conducted
by NGO namely 'Movement Against State
Repression', found that 1360 farmers had
committed suicide in just one district of
Punjab in a span of 17 years due to debt-
burden;
(b) if so, what is the average debt-burden
on a farmer-household in the State and how
it compares with other States and country
as a whole;
(c) the total number of such suicides in
the State during the last five years; and
(d) the steps taken to stop such suicides?
Amending the Human Organ
Transplant Act
*363. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government plan to amend
the Human Organ Transplant Act, 1994 to
promote cadaver transplantation and brain
stem cell transplantation; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?

115
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Decline in cultivable land
*364. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that per capita
availability of cultivable land in the country
has declined from 0.27 hectares in 1980 to
0.16 hectares in 2005;
(b) if so, how the Central Government
are persuading the States to formulate
suitable legislation to bring more and more
land under cultivation and use less
agriculture land for non-agricultural purposes
such as roads, industries, etc.; and
(c) to what extent Government's
Watershed Development Programmes such
as National Watershed Development
Project for Rainfed Areas, Soil Conservation
for Enhancing Productivity in Degraded
Lands, Integrated Wasteland Development
Programme, etc. have helped it in bringing
more and more area under cultivation?
Subsidy on export of sugar
†*365. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to give subsidy on export of
sugar;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the likely financial burden on
Government due to the same?
MSP of pulses, oil-seeds, etc.
*366. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the traders in
the country are feeding on high food prices
but the farmers are made to starve due to
Government policy of not making any
increase in the MSP of pulses, oil-seeds and
rice;
(b) whether it is also a fact that although
the price of tur dal has increased by
Rs. 4 per kg. this year, the Ministry allowed
only 10 paise per kg. increase for the
farmers; and
(c) if so, the steps Government propose
to take so that farmers in the country get a
good price for their produce?
Supply to States for distribution to
BPL people
*367. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION  be pleased to state:
(a) the total supply of wheat, sugar, rice,
kerosene made available to the State
Governments for distribution through fair
price shops for BPL people during the last
five years, State-wise and year-wise; and
(b) the total procurement of wheat, rice
and pulses made by Government agencies
during the above period at minimum support
price, year-wise?
Crop loss due to rains, hailstorm, etc.
†*368. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the crops of
wheat, mustard and green vegetables in some
parts of the country have suffered due to
unseasonal rains, hailstorm, storms and
snowfall in March, 2007;

116
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, what steps have been taken by
Government to compensate the loss caused
to the farmers; and
(c) the amount, so far, provided to the
farmers by Government to take them out of
these disasters?
Plundering of coal from goods train
†*369. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
 Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that a huge quantity of coal was
plundered from a goods train at the outer of
Northern Railway and North Central
Railway near Palwal railway station on 16th-
17th March, 2007;
(b) the time span within which the
plundering was committed by the plunderers;
(c) whether this incident was reported
to the Railway Protection Force;
(d) if so, the action taken by the Railway
Protection Force and the number of persons
arrested; and
(e) since when this plundering of coal
has been taking place and when this case
came in cognizance of Government?
Survey of green house gas emission
*370. SHRI BHAGIRATHI MAJHI:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have done
baseline survey of the green house gas
emissions from different sources in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, what is the source of data and
its authenticity on the emissions; and
(d) whether Government have any plan
to institute study on India's carbon dioxide
and other green house gases emission
levels?
Price control of medicines
†*371. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
 Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had brought medicines under price control
in order to make available medicines to
common man at low prices;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that in
spite of announcement by Government the
prices of medicines were not reduced by
pharmaceutical companies;
(c) if so, the details of such companies
thereof;
(d) whether any action has been taken
by Government against such companies;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
outcome thereof?
Export potential of organic foods
*372. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that organically
grown products have export potential;
(b) if so, the assistance being given to
farmers to adopt organic farming; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

117
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Sanction to new rail line projects
†*373. SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
 Will the Minister of RAILWAYS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government  have not
accorded sanction to some new railway line
projects due to lack of resources; and
(b) whether in view of the lack of proper
railway network in Rajasthan, the State
Government propose to accord sanction
to the projects i.e. Bhiwadi-Delhi-
Ahmedabad, Jaisalmer-Sanu-Jaisalmer,
Badmer and Jaipur-Nathdwara rail lines,
taking into consideration the development
of industry, minerals and tourism in the
State?
Sewage treatment plants
*374. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a study
conducted by the Centre for Science and
Environment has indicated that many of
the rivers in the country are headed towards
an environmental disaster;
(b) if so, the details of the report and
Government's response thereto;
(c) whether it is a fact that a large number
of sewage treatment plants in the country
do not meet the standards for the discharge
of affluents; and
(d) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the details of the projects set up to clean
major rivers, funds earmarked, spent and
results achieved, so far, project-wise?
Industries polluting river Bagad
†*375. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the action taken by
Government during last ten months against
Jubrilant Organic, Ramganga Fertilizers,
etc. which pollute the Bagad river a tributary
of river Ganga at Jyotibafule Nagar;
(b) if no action has been taken, the
reasons therefor; and
(c) by when Government would take
action to close these factories (industries)
alongwith the details thereof?
Payment to insured farmers under
National Agricultural Insurance
Scheme
†*376. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to release Rs. 26.13 crores to Rajasthan
State as the remaining amount of Centre's
share for making payment to the insured
farmers for the Kharif season, 2005 under
National Agricultural Insurance Scheme; and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?
Extortion of money by GRP and State
police
*377. MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of trains prone to
extortion of money by GRP personnel,
State Government police, RPF and railway
staff from gullible passengers;

118
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) the details of such cases decided/
disposed of during the last three years and
those pending as on date;
(c) the names of personnel involved in
each case; and
(d) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
to prevent recurrence of such cases?
Allocation of levy sugar in
Chhattisgarh
†*378. SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
 Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION  be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of levy sugar allocated
for poor ration card holder families of
Chhattisgarh every month during 2002-03
and 2003-04;
(b) the quantity of levy sugar allocated
for January and February, 2007; month-wise;
(c) the reasons for allocation of less
quantity; and
(d) whether any request has been
received from the State Government for
increasing the quantity of allocation of levy
sugar and if so, Government's reaction
thereto?
Rail line between Una to Talwara
*379. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of RAILWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) what is the latest position of the
railway line which is being constructed from
Una to Talwara in Himachal Pradesh;
(b) what is its estimated cost; and
(c) what is the targeted period for its
completion?
NCF recommendations
*380. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have examined
the recommendation of the National
Commission on Farmers(NCF);
(b) if so, the details of the main
recommendations of NCF, indicating those
which has been accepted by Government;
and
(c) the time likely to be taken to
implement these accepted recommen-
dations of NCF?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 21st April, 2007 Secretary-General.

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the April 27, 2007/Vaisakha 7, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Consumer Affairs; Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions — 155
531
Out-break of bird-flu
2727. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware
about the out-breaks of H5N1 bird-flu in
neighbouring Pakistan which is setting off
alarm bells in India;
(b) whether Government have alerted
our border States to be watchful;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government have taken any
step to prevent the out-breaks of bird-flu;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Export of mangoes to America and
Japan
2728. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the United States of
America and Japan have given permission
for the export of Indian mangoes into their
market;
(b) if so, how many tonnes of mangoes
are expected to be exported to these two
countries during the current season;
(c) which varieties of mangoes, available
in Andhra Pradesh, West Bengal and Uttar
Pradesh would avail the opportunity of
export;
(d) how much foreign exchange is
estimated to be earned from the trade;
(e) whether steps have been initiated to
create awareness on quality produce and
also provide incentives to the farmers to
boost the mango exports; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Fisheries harbours on Gujarat coast
2729. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any feasibility survey was
undertaken within the last six years by the
Central Institute of Coastal Engineering for
Fishery (CICEF) for proposed fisheries
harbours on Gujarat coast;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there is any planning to take
up the work of new harbours during the
Eleventh Five Year Plan; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

532
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Non-acceptance of compensation by
farmers
†2730. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
despite non-acceptance of the compensation
by farmers in various States, their land is
acquired and after expiry of the purpose of
land acquisition, the acquired lands are not
returned to them;
(b) whether Government are making
huge profits by selling the lands of the
farmers at an exorbitant rates to private
establishments and companies by converting
the use of the land so acquired;
(c) whether Government intend to bring
a Bill to give right of land to farmers and to
protect them against such arbitrariness and
exploitation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Crop loss due to heavy rains and
hailstorms
2731. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the names of States whose farmers
were affected due to heavy rains and
hailstorms in the recent past;
(b) the state-wise damage to standing
crops in areas due to the said hailstorms;
and
(c) whether Government are going to
provide any relief package for the farmers
who have faced heavy damage of their
standing crops and the State-wise details,
thereof?
Export and import of sugar
2732. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have allowed conditional export of two milion
tonnes of sugar;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the country is also importing
sugar; and
(d) if so, the quantity being imported and
sources thereof?
 Setting up of ADRC
2733. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the Minister
of AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal for setting up of a new Agriculture
Debt Relief Commission to protect the
interests of farmers; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
 Scheme for crops production and
input management in Goa
2734. SHRI SHANTARAM LAXMAN
NAIK: Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any scheme for crops
production and input management is in force
in Goa;
(b) the details of essential features of
the scheme;
(c) the details of projects undertaken/

533
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
implemented under the scheme during the
last five years in the State; and
(d) the details of financial assistance
granted to the State during the last five years,
year-wise?
 Availability of fodder under Intensive
Milk Development Project in Kangra
†2735. SHRI HARISH RAWAT : Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the arrangement to provide fodder
for she calves of the jersey breed belonging
to selected cattle-breeders under the
Intensive Milk Development Project running
in Kangra district of Himachal Pradesh;
(b) the number of she-calves in the age
group of 4 to 12 months for which fodder
has been made available in the veterinary
hospital, Lambagram, Tehsil Jaysinghpur,
District Kangra Dwar from 1st April, 2006
to 31st December, 2006;
(c) the reasons for not providing fodder
for she-calves during this period; and
(d) the arrangement made by the
department to make up affected physical
development of mal-nourished she-calves
due to unavailability of fodder on determined
time?
 Compensation to farmers of border
area
2736. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether there is any proposal/scheme
to provide adequate compensation to the
farmers of border area particularly from
Kathua to Rajouri in J&K, whose
agricultural land has been rendered unfit
for agricultural purposes;
(b) whether any survey has been
conducted in this regard; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
 Free inputs and services to farmers
under extension system
2737. DR. ABHISHEK MANU
SINGHVI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a fundamental
limitation in the current extension system
affecting the crop growing relates to
distribution of free inputs and services to
farmers;
(b) if so, whether this does not result in
dependency on Government and mostly
farmers to look to extension for a "hand out"
rather than a reliable source of technology
and information; and
(c) what steps have been taken to
streamline the system so that small and
marginal farmers get full information
preferable in their mother tongue and thus
free inputs and services become easily
available to them?
 National Agriculture Technology
Project
2738. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
a World Bank project "National Agriculture

534
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Technology Project" was set up in 1998 to
support long-term objectives of promoting
comprehensive and sustained agricultural
growth and rural development; and
(b) if so, whether NATP has been
completed and what are its
recommendations relating to strengthening
the research capacity and management
systems of the Indian Council of Agricultural
Research to address poverty and rural-
oriented sustainability of agricultural growth?
 Foodgrain production in Bihar
†2739. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of foodgain production in
Bihar during the last five years till date, year-
wise;
(b) the details of production of kharif,
rabi, pules, oilseeds, milk and fish and other
commodities during the above said period,
year-wise;
(c) at present what is the requirement of
foodgrains in the State and what is the
current production; and
(d) what would be the total requirement
of foodgrains in the State till 2020?
 Welfare of fishermen
2740. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of fishermen in the
country, State-wise and UT-wise;
(b) whether Government have developed
any system of marketing the fishes for
ensuring the livelihood of the families
entirely dependent upon fisheries in the
regions like the Islands of Lakshadweep,
Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Goa, Kerala,
Orissa, etc., and if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government are preparing
the guidelines in the rationing system to
ensure kerosene oil to the fishermen families
for the use of fishing purposes; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Agriculture Year
2741. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposal to declare 2007-08 as an
Agriculture Year;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken thereon?
 Performance of KCC at Jaipur
2742. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether only thirteen Kisan Call
Centres are located in different parts of the
country, including one at Jaipur in Rajasthan;
(b) whether said Call Centres would be
adequate to provide the information to the
farmers throughout the country and to the
largest desert State of Rajasthan; and
(c) what has been their performance/
output during 2006-07 and whether it could
be termed as satisfactory?
 Food security
2743. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that food security
in the country is under serious threat and
the long term plans to address the malaise
are not in place as the problem itself is not
acknowledged;

535
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether it is a fact that last year we
imported 5.5 million tonnes of wheat after a
six year hiatus and this supply side shortage
may result in India becoming net importer
of food products again; and
(c) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to improve the acreage under the
agriculture?
 Procurement by private sectors
2744. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have finally
decided to allow private sectors’ participation
in the procurement, marketing and selling of
farm produce in the States; and
(b) if so, the details thereof including the
names of the States which have agreed to
amend their Agricultural Produce Marketing
Committee Acts?
 Use of chemical fertilizers
†2745. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the total acres of land throughout the
country where chemical fertilizers are used
at present;
(b) the quantity of fertilizers in kilogram
used for per acre of land in India as
compared to the international level; and
(c) the details of the percentage of such
farmers who use fertilizers in the country?
Production of foodgrains
2746. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the total production expected of
foodgrains such as wheat, rice, jawar, bajra,
pulses, fruits and vegetables like onion,
potatoes, during 2006-07;
(b) whether the production has
increased in comparison to the last two
years i.e. 2004-05 and 2005-06, the
comparative figures thereof, item-wise and
year-wise;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the list of items of agriculture
products which were banned for export due
to shortage in the country from time to
time?
 National Horticulture Mission
2747. MS. MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the elements of the National
Horticulture Mission;
(b) the cultivations included thereunder;
(c) whether the orange cultivation has
been included in it;
(d) if so, whether Government have
taken into cognizance the plight of the
orange cultivators of Jhalawar due to lack
of storage and upgraded marketing
infrastructure;
(e) the steps being taken to upgrade the
storage and marketing infrastructure there;
and
(f) the details of the steps taken by
Government to encourage the food
processing unit in that region?

536
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
 Livestock insurance project in
Kerala
2748. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) wether a livestock insurance project
is implemented in two districts viz.,
Alappuzha and Palakkad in Kerala;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government have any plan
to extend the project to other districts in the
State?
 Amendment in the Agriculture
Produce Marketing Act
2749. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
to amend the Agricultural Produce
Marketing Act, which is a hindrance in the
development of food processing industry;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken to rectify the
deficiencies?
 Food security
†2750. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that people of this
country are suspicious and anxious about
food security;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
continuous decline in foodgrain production
has resulted into crisis of food security;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the quantity of foodgrains that
would be required by 2020 alongwith the
quantity   required at present in the country?
Growth of livestock and fishery sector
2751. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set a
target of six percent growth per year for
the livestock and fisheries sector during the
Eleventh Five Year Plan;
(b) what was the annual average growth
of the livestock and fisheries sector during
the Tenth Five Year Plan;
(c) what would be the inputs required
for Government to meet the six percent
growth rate in the livestock and fisheries
sector during the Eleventh Five Year Plan;
(d) whether it is a fact that this target
was set whimsically without considering
diverse constraints; and
(e) the steps proposed to carefully
review these targets?
 Special Agricultural Zones
2752. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
anything on the Special Agricultural Zones
as proposed by reputed scientist Dr. M.S.
Swaminathan; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
